title: Taking God at His Word: Trusting Him in the Little Things
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful story of how trust in God's promises can lead to incredible breakthroughs in your life. From a pivotal moment at a winter camp meeting where Pastor Chris encountered the "fire of God" to learning the importance of trusting God with even the smallest details, this sermon will inspire you to take a leap of faith and see God's goodness in your life. Don't miss this encouraging message that will challenge you to trust God with everything.
